items.title: The module constructed from the double dual is injective
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the module constructed from the double dual is injective (statement lines 1194-1199). The proof is a complete argument: the functor of homomorphisms into the constructed module is rewritten by a chain of displayed identifications, using the hom-tensor adjunction and the description of the construction, as a functor of homomorphisms out of a tensor product with a flat module (proof lines 1201-1213); that functor is exact because tensoring by a flat module is exact and the target is injective, so the constructed module is injective (proof lines 1214-1216). The non-formal content is the chain of adjunction identifications. The claim is H2.
